`final class WindowVulkanHost`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkanhost/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.host` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [WindowVulkanHost.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/host/WindowVulkanHost.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The Vulkan host of a GLFW window, which owns the instance, the device and a swapchain that follows the size of the window.

## Description

It presents in `MAILBOX` when the surface offers it, `FIFO` otherwise.

```java fragment
final WindowVulkanHost host = WindowVulkanHost.create(window);
final VulkanBackend backend = VulkanBackend.create(window, host).register();
```

## Creation details

<a id="WindowVulkanHost-factory-create"></a>

### create

`WindowVulkanHost create(long window)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the host of the window with 2 frames in flight.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when Vulkan is missing, or when no Vulkan 1.3 device can present to the window.

`WindowVulkanHost create(long window, int framesInFlight)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: A Vulkan window host needs at least one frame in flight, got …: pass 1 to wait for each frame, 2 or more to record the next frame while the GPU draws the previous ones

Creates the host of the window with that many frames in flight: `1` waits for each frame, `2` or more records the next frame while the GPU draws the previous ones.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` below `1`.

<a id="WindowVulkanHost-method-beginFrame"></a>

### beginFrame

`this beginFrame()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The Vulkan window frame has already begun, call endFrame() first

Waits for the slot of the frame, acquires the next image of the swapchain, recreating it when the window changed size, starts the command buffer and clears the image to black.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when a frame is already begun.

<a id="WindowVulkanHost-method-endFrame"></a>

### endFrame

`this endFrame()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The Vulkan window frame has not begun, call beginFrame() first

Ends the command buffer, submits it and presents the image.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no frame is begun.

<a id="WindowVulkanHost-method-destroy"></a>

### destroy

`void destroy()` 

Waits for the device and destroys the swapchain, the surface, the device and the instance; call it after `VulkanBackend.destroy()`.
